name: Dr. Samuel Osei
want: keep the injured alive until they are aboard something
secret: He has a heart condition he hid from the Consortium's medical board, and has already decided to give his seat away and stay.
voice: Slow, warm, a little formal; never raises his voice, even now.
description: The station's doctor and its oldest hand, on his last posting before retirement. People tell him things.
appearance: Tall and stooped, close-cropped white hair, reading glasses on a cord, sleeves rolled and gloved to the elbow.
